title: Dead Loads and Unit Weights
verified_by: Rounaq, manual check against page_045.png and crop_cl_19_2.png

items.heading: Dead Loads
items.text: Dead loads shall be calculated on the basis of unit weights which shall be established taking into consideration the materials specified for construction.

items.heading: Unit Weights of Concrete
items.text: Alternatively, the dead loads may be calculated on the basis of unit weights of materials given in IS 875 (Part 1). Unless more accurate calculations are warranted, the unit weights of plain concrete and reinforced concrete made with sand and gravel or crushed natural stone aggregate may be taken as 24 kN/m3 and 25 kN/m3 respectively.
